source_title: 목자판 영상의 수위 추정 모델 비교와 최종 오류 분석
comparison: v4: resplit training/validation data and multi-task water-level/obstacle model
calculation_scope: Unit conversions and changes are recalculated from the displayed rounded report aggregates, not from original image-level predictions.
limitations: Original image-level predictions are not included; RMSE, MAE and P95 cannot be independently recomputed here.
The internal test was used in v3 error analysis; these are not results from a new external environment.
Threshold counts overlap and must not be summed.
Lower aggregate errors do not mean every image improved: absolute errors over 1 m increased from 28 to 31.
